projects.title: A Sports | Pakistan's first HD Sports Channel
projects.site: A Sports | Pakistan's first HD Sports Channel
projects.excerpt: Backend WordPress developer for Pakistan's first HD sports channel. The site runs headless — I built a custom content API to feed the website frontend and mobile apps, and implemented Redis for caching.

body.text: Role

Worked as a backend WordPress developer on A Sports, Pakistan's first HD sports channel. The site runs in a headless state — WordPress is used purely as the content engine, with no public frontend served from it.
Custom Content API
Built a custom API on top of WordPress to handle content delivery to all consumers:

items: Serves curated content to the website frontend
Delivers the same structured content to the mobile apps
Exposes exactly the fields the consumers need — no over-fetching

body.text: Configuration Plugin
Built a custom WordPress plugin that powers the API and gives admins dashboard control over how content is served:

items: Lets admins pick which content appears on configurable endpoints like the homepage straight from the dashboard — no code changes needed
Exposes cache settings and per-endpoint cache timeouts as admin options
Keeps endpoint configuration centralized in the plugin rather than scattered across consumer apps

body.text: Performance & Caching
Implemented Redis as a caching layer to cut repeated database hits and keep API responses fast, so the frontend and mobile apps get quick, consistent content delivery under load.
Cache behaviour is managed through the plugin — admins control the cache settings and the timeout for each endpoint, balancing freshness against speed per use case.

projects.title: Al Khaja Stores
projects.excerpt: Full e-commerce build on WordPress — a WoodMart theme storefront powered by WooCommerce, with custom payment gateways for a seamless checkout.

body.text: Overview

alkhajastores.ae is a complete online store built on WordPress using the WoodMart theme, a high-performance WooCommerce theme. Configured the storefront end-to-end for a fast, responsive shopping experience across devices.
Store & Catalogue
The store runs on WooCommerce, handling products, cart, checkout and order management — with the theme and plugin stack tuned for speed and conversion.
Payments

Enabled custom payment gateways so customers can pay directly through the store rather than relying on WooCommerce's default options. Each gateway was integrated, configured and tested against the live checkout flow.

Worked on arysahulatbazar.pk across custom functionality, API development, third-party integrations and ongoing support on the WordPress platform.

API Development

Integrations & Support
